verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows the host listing currently connected guests or offering a way to disconnect or revoke a device. The nearest items are adjacent controls that do not deliver this story: app-level permissions for connected guests, audit logs via the Teams API, blocking computers from hosting, and time-limited guest access credits.

support.subject: As a power user, the host shows who is connected right now, and I can disconnect or revoke a device from the host
